jsonld.name: I&S Exclusive Carpentry
jsonld.description: Custom carpentry business in Medley, FL run by Isaias and Susana: custom closets, kitchen cabinets and cabinet remodeling for homes across Miami-Dade.

parrafo.es: I&S Exclusive Carpentry diseña e instala closets, gabinetes de cocina y carpintería de remodelación en Medley, FL y alrededores. Isaias y Susana atienden cada proyecto en persona, de principio a fin.
parrafo.en: I&S Exclusive Carpentry designs and installs custom closets, kitchen cabinets and remodeling carpentry across Medley, FL and the surrounding area. Isaias and Susana handle every project in person, start to finish.

hero.imagen_alt: Custom closet with corner shelving and drawers built by I&S Exclusive Carpentry in Medley, FL

parrafo_1.es: I&S Exclusive Carpentry es un negocio familiar de Medley, FL. Isaias y Susana diseñan, construyen e instalan cada closet y gabinete ellos mismos: el mismo equipo que cotiza el trabajo es el que llega a tu casa a instalarlo.
parrafo_1.en: I&S Exclusive Carpentry is a family-run business based in Medley, FL. Isaias and Susana design, build and install every closet and cabinet themselves: the same team that quotes the job is the one who shows up to install it.

parrafo_2.es: 225 reseñas en Google respaldan el trabajo, con una calificación perfecta de 5.0. Clientes de Coral Gables a Medley destacan su puntualidad, su atención al detalle y la calidad de los acabados.
parrafo_2.en: 225 reviews on Google back up the work, with a perfect 5.0 rating. Customers from Coral Gables to Medley single out their punctuality, attention to detail and the quality of the finish.

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué espacio quieres transformar: closet, cocina o un mueble a medida. Respondemos por teléfono directo, sin centrales ni formularios.
texto.en: Tell us what space you want to transform: a closet, a kitchen or a custom piece. We answer by direct phone, no call centers, no forms.

texto.es: Isaias y Susana miden el espacio en persona y te ayudan a definir el diseño que mejor aprovecha cada rincón.
texto.en: Isaias and Susana measure the space in person and help you work out the design that makes the most of every corner.

texto.es: Fabrican e instalan el closet o gabinete con el cuidado y la puntualidad que destacan las 225 reseñas.
texto.en: They build and install the closet or cabinet with the care and punctuality highlighted across all 225 reviews.

texto.es: Revisan juntos el resultado terminado, entregan en la fecha prometida y dejan el área limpia.
texto.en: They walk the finished result with you, deliver on the promised date and leave the area clean.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el espacio y los materiales. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the space and materials. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Diseño e instalación de closets exclusivos que aprovechan cada centímetro del espacio, el servicio que más mencionan sus clientes.
texto.en: Design and installation of exclusive closets that make use of every inch of space, the service clients mention most.

texto.es: Remodelación de gabinetes de cocina con acabados de calidad y atención meticulosa al detalle.
texto.en: Kitchen cabinet remodels with quality finishes and meticulous attention to detail.

texto.es: Renovación de gabinetes existentes en casas y apartamentos, con trabajo limpio y a tiempo.
texto.en: Renovation of existing cabinets in houses and apartments, done cleanly and on time.

texto.es: Muebles y carpintería de acabado hechos a medida para proyectos de remodelación completos.
texto.en: Custom-built furniture and finish carpentry for full remodeling projects.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Llámanos y te confirmamos si podemos ayudarte.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you need? Call us and we will confirm whether we can help.

items.quote: Isaias and his wife Susana did a job for me in my Coral Gables apartment. Results were excellent! Job performed was done timely, with professionalism and cleanliness! I fully recommend I&S for any carpentry related job

I recently hired I&S exclusive carpentry for a kitchen cabinet remodel, and I couldn't be more pleased with the results. Their craftsmanship is exceptional, with meticulous attention to detail. They were professional, respectful of my home, …
Great service and great quality cabinets. They delivered the closets by the promised date. It was a pleasure to work with Isaias and Suzanna.
